---
format:
  typst:
    papersize: a4
    margin:
      x: 2cm
      y: 2.2cm
---

```{=typst}
// QA report template. All content comes from qa-data.json, written by
// pipeworks::qa_report(). Plain Typst: no R runs while rendering.
#let d = json("qa-data.json")
#let ink = rgb("#1f2933")
#let muted = rgb("#6b7785")
#let rule = rgb("#cfd6dd")
#let green = rgb("#2f7d4f")
#let amber = rgb("#b26a00")
#let red = rgb("#b3261e")

#let verdicts = (
  correct: ("Correct", green),
  check_again: ("Correct, callee changed: check again", amber),
  questionable: ("Questionable", amber),
  wrong: ("Wrong", red),
  unreviewed: ("Open: not reviewed", red),
  changed: ("Open: changed since review", red),
  self_reviewed: ("Open: reviewed by its author", red),
)
#let verdict-cell(v) = {
  let entry = verdicts.at(v, default: (v, red))
  text(fill: entry.at(1), weight: "bold", entry.at(0))
}
#let names(list) = if list.len() == 0 { [not available] } else { list.join(", ") }
#let tile(value, label, color: ink) = block(
  width: 100%, inset: 10pt, radius: 4pt, stroke: 0.6pt + rule,
  align(center)[
    #text(size: 24pt, weight: "bold", fill: color)[#value] \
    #text(size: 9pt, fill: muted)[#label]
  ],
)

#set text(size: 10pt, fill: ink)
#set par(justify: false, leading: 0.6em)
#set page(
  header: if not d.passed {
    align(center, block(width: 100%, fill: red, inset: 5pt, radius: 2pt,
      text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 10pt)[DRAFT – QA incomplete]))
  },
  footer: context [
    #set text(size: 8pt, fill: muted)
    #d.project · #d.version
    #h(1fr)
    Page #counter(page).display() of #counter(page).final().first()
  ],
)

// ---- Cover ----
#v(1.5cm)
#if d.organisation != none [
  #text(size: 11pt, fill: muted, weight: "bold", d.organisation) \
]
#text(size: 26pt, weight: "bold")[#d.title] \
#text(size: 15pt, fill: muted)[#d.project]
#v(0.6cm)

#table(
  columns: (auto, 1fr), stroke: none, inset: (x: 0pt, y: 4pt), column-gutter: 14pt,
  text(fill: muted)[Code version],
  d.version,
  text(fill: muted)[Analyst(s)], names(d.analysts),
  text(fill: muted)[Reviewer(s)], names(d.reviewers),
  text(fill: muted)[Created], d.date,
)
#v(0.4cm)

#grid(
  columns: (1fr,) * 4, column-gutter: 8pt,
  tile(d.counts.items, [items]),
  tile(d.counts.correct, [correct], color: green),
  tile(d.counts.questionable, [questionable], color: amber),
  tile(d.counts.wrong_open, [wrong or open], color: if d.counts.wrong_open > 0 { red } else { ink }),
)
#v(0.5cm)

#if d.passed [
  Every function and target definition in this code version was reviewed by a second analyst who did not write it. Each verdict refers to the exact code identified by its hash; code that changed after a review was reviewed again.
] else [
  #block(stroke: 1pt + red, inset: 10pt, radius: 3pt)[
    *This report does not confirm the review.*
    #if d.draft_reason == "uncommitted" [
      The working copy has uncommitted changes in code or review entries, so the reviewed code cannot be tied to a commit. Commit them and render the report again.
    ] else if d.draft_reason == "empty" [
      No reviewable items were found, so there is nothing to confirm.
    ] else [
      #d.counts.wrong_open item(s) are wrong or still open, so the QA check does not pass for this code version. The list of open items follows below.
    ]
  ]
]

#v(0.5cm)
#text(weight: "bold")[Pipeline blocks]
#v(2pt)
#text(size: 8.5pt, fill: muted)[Each box is a source file. Arrows point from the block that provides code or data to the block that uses it.]
#v(4pt)
#let level-count = d.levels.len()
#grid(
  columns: range(level-count).map(_ => (1fr, auto)).flatten().slice(0, -1),
  column-gutter: 4pt, row-gutter: 6pt,
  ..range(level-count).map(i => {
    let boxes = d.levels.at(i).map(b => block(
      width: 100%, inset: 6pt, radius: 3pt, stroke: 0.6pt + rule, fill: rgb("#f4f6f8"),
      text(size: 8.5pt, raw(b)),
    ))
    let col = stack(dir: ttb, spacing: 5pt, ..boxes)
    if i < level-count - 1 { (col, align(horizon, text(fill: muted, size: 14pt)[→])) } else { (col,) }
  }).flatten(),
)

// ---- Open items ----
#if d.open.len() > 0 [
  #pagebreak()
  = Open items
  The following items do not have a valid review yet.
  #v(4pt)
  #table(
    columns: (1fr, auto, auto), stroke: (x: none, y: 0.4pt + rule), inset: 5pt,
    table.header([*Item*], [*Block*], [*State*]),
    ..d.open.map(o => (raw(o.id), text(size: 9pt)[#o.block], verdict-cell(o.verdict))).flatten(),
  )
]

// ---- Findings ----
#pagebreak()
= Findings by block
#for b in d.blocks [
  == #raw(b.block)
  #table(
    columns: (auto, 1fr, auto, auto, auto, auto), stroke: (x: none, y: 0.4pt + rule),
    inset: 5pt, align: (left, left, left, left, left, left),
    table.header([*Item*], [*Title*], [*Verdict*], [*Reviewer*], [*Date*], [*Hash*]),
    ..b.items.map(i => (
      text(size: 8.5pt, raw(i.id)),
      text(size: 9pt, i.title),
      text(size: 9pt, verdict-cell(i.verdict)),
      text(size: 9pt, if i.reviewer != none { i.reviewer } else { [–] }),
      text(size: 9pt, if i.date != none { i.date } else { [–] }),
      text(size: 8pt, raw(i.hash7)),
      ..if i.comment != none {
        (table.cell(colspan: 6, inset: (left: 14pt, y: 4pt),
          text(size: 9pt, style: "italic", fill: muted)[Comment: #i.comment]),)
      } else { () },
    )).flatten(),
  )
  #v(6pt)
]

// ---- Review history ----
#if d.history.len() > 0 [
  = Review history
  Merges that brought review entries into this code version.
  #v(4pt)
  #table(
    columns: (1fr, auto, auto, auto), stroke: (x: none, y: 0.4pt + rule), inset: 5pt,
    table.header([*Branch*], [*Items*], [*Review rounds*], [*Merged*]),
    ..d.history.map(h => (raw(h.branch), [#h.items], [#h.rounds], h.merged)).flatten(),
  )
]

// ---- Signatures ----
#v(1cm)
#block(breakable: false)[
  #if not d.passed [
    #text(fill: muted)[Draft – not for signature.]
  ] else if d.signatures [
    = Signatures
    #v(1.2cm)
    #grid(
      columns: (1fr, 1fr), column-gutter: 1.5cm,
      [#line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.6pt) Analyst: #names(d.analysts) \ Date, signature],
      [#line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.6pt) Reviewer: #names(d.reviewers) \ Date, signature],
    )
  ] else [
    #text(fill: muted)[This report was generated digitally and is valid without signature.]
  ]
]
```
